scope: Proposition 6.2 (Transfer bound) of the manuscript “Brennan's conjecture and sharp inverse-square integral means” (preprints/Brennans-conjecture-and-sharp-inverse-square-integral-means-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 072 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 27a773e887282fd9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The dyadic transfer operator satisfies ρ ≤ 2.
